suggested_routes.label: Onboarding access issue — Brookmint Holdings invitation failure
suggested_routes.rationale: The contact reported that an invitation sent to Brookmint Holdings did not work when they tried to use it, and proposed attempting the invitation again together. This is a concrete onboarding or access problem involving an existing or onboarding customer that requires immediate follow-up.

suggested_routes.label: Investigate invitation/access system issue
suggested_routes.rationale: The failed invitation may indicate an underlying system or configuration problem (expired link, permissions issue). An internal technical investigation is warranted to prevent the same issue recurring for other customers.

concise_output: A contact reported that the invitation for Brookmint Holdings failed — either expired or otherwise broken — and suggested retrying the invitation together during this session. This is an urgent onboarding access issue requiring immediate resolution and an internal root-cause investigation.
what_established: An invitation was sent to Brookmint Holdings. When the recipient tried to use it, it did not work. The meeting was called to retry the invitation and resolve the access issue.
what_not_established: Whether Brookmint Holdings is an existing or prospective customer, the cause of the invitation failure, deal value, or whether the retry succeeded.
next_action: Resend a fresh invitation to Brookmint Holdings during or after the session; investigate why the original invitation failed (expiry, permissions, link generation bug) and fix the root cause.
uncertainty: The cause of the invitation failure and the outcome of the retry are not captured in the available evidence.
